item.title: The 90-year history of the binoculars bolted to scenic overlooks
item.description:
📝 Tower Optical In many places, these viewers have become part of the landscape as much as a means of viewing it. Many units still have the original Bausch & Lomb optics inside. Tower Optical assembled every machine by hand at its Norwalk factory, which still houses the original manufacturing equipment from the 1930s and ’40s.

item.title: Apple announces changes for apps in the European Union
item.description:
📝 Under the new terms: For App Store apps using Apple In-App Purchase, the commission will be 26 percent. For App Store apps using alternative payment processing, the commission will be 20 percent. For apps distributed via alternative app marketplaces or the web, Apple will charge a 5 percent Core Technology Commission.
🔗 Read more: https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/08/apple-announces-changes-for-apps-in-the-european-union/
